bullets: Developed and maintained backend data pipelines in Python to interface with the Wiz security platform via GraphQL APIs, replacing extensive manual data compilation processes.

Programmed a backend risk-based remediation engine in Python that parses vulnerability data payloads, automatically cross-referencing CVSS scores, exploitability metrics, and business impact to prioritize high-risk assets.
Designed and implemented an automated data analytics pipeline to track vulnerability trends over time, providing leadership with enhanced visibility into system patching metrics across product lines.
Built an internal Python dashboard that unifies data from multiple vulnerability scanners into a single view of each product's vulnerability posture and SLA metrics.
Assisted application development teams during security incident windows by analyzing codebase exposure, validating software fixes, and tracking emergency patch status for zero-day vulnerabilities.
Led bi-weekly/monthly technical synchronization meetings with product development teams to review security backlogs, resolve code-level blockers, and ensure rapid adherence to remediation SLAs.
